rules.name: cs-24-diff-funnel-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT c.rows_in_cache, c.min_value_date, c.max_value_date, v.valuation_value_date, CASE WHEN c.min_value_date = :valueDate AND c.max_value_date = :valueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cache_on_value_date FROM (SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_cache, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(business_unit) = 'CFS') c CROSS JOIN (SELECT max(value_date) AS valuation_value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(business_unit) = 'CFS') v

SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, c.contract_number, c.trade_id, c.derivative_type, c.instrument, c.market_action, c.active_lots, c.settlement_date, c.fixing_date, c.traded_price::text AS cache_price_text, dp.premium::text AS deal_ticket_price_text, cd.premium::text AS clone_price_text, round(c.traded_price::numeric, 4) AS r4_half_away_decimal, (floor(c.traded_price * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000)::numeric(18,4) AS r4_matlab_product, round(c.traded_price::numeric, 4) <> (floor(c.traded_price * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000)::numeric(18,4) AS methods_differ, c.settle_price, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd, c.fx_nc_factor FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(premium) AS premium, count(DISTINCT premium) AS n FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND is_latest_version = 1 AND premium IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trade_id) dp ON dp.trade_id = c.trade_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(premium) AS premium FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND is_latest_version = 1 GROUP BY trade_id) cd ON cd.trade_id = c.trade_id WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND c.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) ORDER BY client, c.contract_number, c.trade_id

SELECT c.derivative_type, count(*) AS legs, sum(c.mtm_usd) AS sum_exact, round(sum(c.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS rounded_sum, sum(round(c.mtm_usd::numeric, 2)) AS sum_of_leg_rounded, sum(round(c.mtm_usd::numeric, 2)) - round(sum(c.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS diff_leg_vs_sum, sum(c.mkt_value_usd) AS sum_mkt_value_usd, sum(c.premium_paid_usd) AS sum_premium_paid_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = upper(:totalClient) GROUP BY c.derivative_type ORDER BY c.derivative_type

SELECT count(*) AS legs, sum(c.mtm_usd) AS sum_exact, round(sum(c.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS rounded_sum, sum(round(c.mtm_usd::numeric, 2)) AS sum_of_leg_rounded FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = upper(:totalClient)

SELECT c.contract_number, c.trade_id, c.derivative_type, c.product_code, c.instrument, c.subportfolio, c.contract_month, c.underlying1_id, c.underlying2_id, c.active_lots, s.product_code AS security_product_code, s.underlying1_id AS security_underlying1, p.invenio_product_code, p.bbg_product_code, p.product_name, p.lot_mult, p.murex_mult FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = c.business_unit AND s.security_id = c.instrument LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND lower(p.invenio_product_code) = lower(c.product_code) WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(c.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) = upper(:smhClient) AND c.contract_number IN ('SMH_OU_056', 'SMH_OU_057', 'SMH_OU_060') ORDER BY c.contract_number, c.trade_id
